statement: NVIDIA announced a new Rubin-generation deployment (design win): Noetra Corp. will build an NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 AI factory in Japan comprising 27,500 Rubin GPUs and 13,750 Vera CPUs across 140 megawatts of data center capacity, developed with Japan's METI.
why: A newly named next-generation (Rubin) deployment at national scale is a concrete forward-demand data point and a design win for NVIDIA's accelerator roadmap.

impact.mechanism: A committed 27,500-GPU, 140MW Rubin AI factory demonstrates forward demand for NVIDIA's next-generation GPUs and the datacenter power and capacity to host them, anchoring multimodal foundation-model workloads.

evidence.excerpt: 13,750 NVIDIA Vera CPUs' and '27,500 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs' with '140 megawatts of data center capacity.

confidence.basis: Primary source: NVIDIA official newsroom press release dated 2026-07-16.
